# Configuration Surface

## Build-Time Configurations

`Cargo.toml` has no `[features]` table and CMake declares no options or
conditional sources. The power set of Rust features therefore has one member:
the empty set. The default and `--no-default-features` builds select that same
configuration.

| # | Rust features | CMake options | [ ] |
|---|---------------|---------------|-----|
| B1 | empty set | none | [x] |

## Runtime Configurations

The sole public entry point is `update_frame_header`. Each row is one member
of the mechanically derived cross-product of every branch equivalence class:
15 block-size classes x 17 sample-rate classes x 4 channel-mode classes x
7 bit-depth classes = 7,140 rows. Within every row, tests randomize values
inside non-singleton classes, `channels`, the incoming `frame_header`, and
all struct padding bytes using a fixed seed.
